expectations.text: Identifies the Article 38 opt-out covering Articles 21, 22 and 33(2)
expectations.evidence: 'under Article 38 ... may opt out of three provisions': 'Article 21 ... Article 22 ... Article 33(2)'

expectations.text: States the opt-out runs five years
expectations.evidence: 'opt out ... for 5 years from the Law's effective date (1 January 2026), i.e. until about 1 January 2031'

expectations.text: Notes micro-enterprises and household businesses are exempt from the same provisions
expectations.evidence: 'Micro-enterprises and household businesses get the exemption on the same conditions'

expectations.text: Makes clear other PDPL duties still apply
expectations.evidence: Extensive 'What you CANNOT defer (applies from 1 January 2026)' section: consent, rights, breach, cross-border, notices, DPO, sector overlays

expectations.text: Does not cite invented chapter numbers
expectations.evidence: No invented chapter numbers; citations are to real articles of Law 91/2025 and Decrees 356/330
